title: One file. From single node to HA cluster.
ledeHtml: Most PaaS platforms cap at vertical scaling — when you grow, you migrate. Most Kubernetes distros assume you're starting big. AppRafter is designed to be the same platform from a €5 VPS to a multi-node HA cluster, and the same Application.cue deploys to both. Tier 1 is live today; Tier 2 (HA) ships in Phase 3.

leftStage.caption: A single VDS. Single-node Postgres. SealedSecrets. Sane defaults.

rightStage.caption: 3+ nodes. CloudNativePG. NATS JetStream. OpenBao secrets. Ships in Phase 3.

caveatHtml: Today: Tier 1 ready at signup. Tier 2 (HA) ships in Phase 3; the T1→T2 migration tool follows in the first post-launch bundle.
